chapter: Washington, New Orleans and the road
title: Winters in Detroit clubs and the Club DeLisa again
summary: He worked the Zombie Club and Sportry's Bar in Detroit, where a stage sat over the bar, then Chicago's Club DeLisa.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: An' I got through runnin' around with that...went back to Chicago, stayed the winter, then I headed back out in the summertime. In the meantime, in the wintertime, I play all up in Detroit, Michigan. Had a club up there called the Zombie Club. Had a club called Sportry's (?) Bar. I used to wrrk back an' forth between Sportry's (?) an' the Zombie Club. At Sportry's (?), they had a stage built up over the bar. You walked along a pathway up, uh...behind the bar, up high, up over the bar. Stood right on the stage, right over th' top o' the bartender over the bar...and sing. Had a coupla dancers there, and they uh, put on a helluva show. I used to back up there quite often. In fact, I lived up there. I stayed up there so much people thought I lived up there.
Ever'where I went, I stayed so long. I would come in back and forth so often..."Seems you just left here two weeks ago. You back again."
Say, "Yeah. Doin' good business for the nightclub owners."
So, then we took off, went back in Chicago an' then I played Chicago, played the Club DeLisa Club where the show where they had the all-night show.
